description.it: Le importazioni di utenti, catalogo e prestiti con il loro esito. Riservato agli amministratori.
description.en: The imports of patrons, catalogue and loans with their outcome. Administrators only.

sql: SELECT ib.kind AS kind, ib.filename AS file, ib.mode AS mode, ib.started_at AS started, ib.finished_at AS finished, ib.summary AS summary FROM import_batch ib ORDER BY ib.started_at DESC
